items: New Server Health widgets: every server address, response times, uptime and what to do, on the Home Screen and Lock Screen.
New Family widgets: everyone's devices, the subscriptions they use, and what needs you.
Tap a widget to open Full Check or the Family page.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
